facts.claim: Vogue reported that most handbags shown in Fall/Winter 2025 were roomy enough for everyday use and explicitly contrasted this with micro bags; the roundup emphasized top-handle bags, classic crossbodies, day bags, and totes. facts.subject: Fall/Winter 2025 handbag runway direction

facts.notes_for_writer: Use as counterevidence to a simple claim that micro bags broadly returned in 2025; do not state that micro bags disappeared.

facts.claim: Vogue's Spring/Summer 2025 handbag roundup said scaled-down minis were being displaced by capacious totes and highlighted functional doctor-bag shapes at Miu Miu, Jil Sander, Hermès, and The Row. ([vogue.com](https://www.vogue.com/article/spring-2025-handbag-trends))

facts.claim: Vogue documented the simultaneous appearance of extremely oversized and extra-small handbags on the same runway season, citing large coin-purse clutches at Coach and tiny leather bags at Fendi. ([vogue.com](https://www.vogue.com/article/are-you-team-mini-or-maxi-bag))

facts.notes_for_writer: Useful evidence for a polarized-size interpretation; avoid converting runway coexistence into proof of equal consumer demand.

facts.claim: Vogue's Summer 2026 handbag coverage identified petite pouches at Prada, Loewe, Miu Miu, and Valentino while also reporting ultra-maxi proportions at Celine, oversized shoulder bags at Altuzarra, and super-roomy totes at Toteme, Stella McCartney, and Kallmeyer. facts.claim: For Fall 2026, Vogue highlighted both compact fashion-led forms—clutches, minaudières, and streamlined east-west bags—and enlarged everyday forms, including shoulder bags from Chanel, Miu Miu, and Bottega Veneta that could hold a laptop. facts.claim: ELLE linked the appeal of very small bags to carrying only a limited set of essentials—such as a phone, wallet, keys, and lip product—and described the bag's value as adding occasion and visual impact rather than storage capacity. facts.claim: A January 2026 Vogue feature on Bulgari's Icons minaudières described the miniature scale as intentional, with utility being deliberately subordinated to meaning; the designs were presented as carrying a miniature book rather than accommodating a phone. facts.claim: Marie Claire's Fall 2026 trend report contrasted tiny summer purses with autumn's return to more substantial bags, while still noting smaller clutches, top-handle bags, and intentional hand-held styling. ([marieclaire.com](https://www.marieclaire.com/fashion/fall-2026-handbag-trends/))

facts.claim: Harper's Bazaar's Fall/Winter 2026 roundup, informed by Shopbop and Mytheresa retail executives, emphasized top-handle bags, croc-embossed totes, flap bags, and embellished shoulder bags; Mytheresa described wearing evening bags during the day as an early-2000s-inspired direction.
